title: wp-ja-morgan's username reminder mails a known address at most once per window and one client at most five addresses per window, and registration creates at most five accounts per client per hour; every reminder answers ok whether or not mail was sent
steps: The test loads overlays/wp-ja-morgan and src/wp-ja-morgan account.php under a PHP stub of WordPress and posts the reminder and registration forms repeatedly from one client.
expect: The run exits 0 with 8 tests passing and 0 failing.
A known address is mailed once per window; later requests in the window answer ok and send nothing.
An unknown address gets the same ok answer and no mail.
One client cannot mail more than five addresses per window.
Registration creates at most five accounts per client per hour, then redirects with error-limit.
evidence: tasks/nhat-ky/2026-10-21-ja-morgan-remind-rate-limit.md. On develop the same test fails 6/8: the reminder mailed a known address on every request and registration created 7 accounts.
fence: The theme's PHP under a WordPress stub. Not covered: a real WordPress, database and mail server, and a republished JA Morgan release.
